examples.title: Create a LightWrap node
examples.code:
# Create the node and keep a reference to it.
lightWrap = nuke.createNode("LightWrap")

examples.code:
# Configure the "disableluma" control.
lightWrap = nuke.createNode("LightWrap")
lightWrap["disableluma"].setValue(True)

examples.code:

print(lightWrap.knobs().keys())
